pairs.reason: Placeholder 'refresh_token' string overwrites the real refresh token when missing.
Computed keys from z.string().toString() in the schema are invalid and collapse to '[object Object]'.
parseRefreshTokenResponse returns the safeParse wrapper, which is stored as the credential key.
In sync mode refreshOAuthTokens returns the raw fetch Response, but Google and HubSpot callers expect token objects.
The Response has no .data, so Google's res?.data and token.access_token throw.
